title: Order Confirmation
description: Order details available at the time of checkout completion.

label.description: Human-readable label for identifying the order. MUST only be provided by the business.

permalink_url.description: Permalink to access the order on merchant site.

access.description: Credential granting the platform authorized access to this order. Businesses SHOULD issue it when the checkout completed without a linked user identity, so post-purchase order operations remain reachable without an account.
